label: Hermes 3000 · 87키
reference: Paillard manual 3003 B and TWDB owner photographs, with user reference sheets as visual targets
accuracy: 87-key web adaptation. Component relationships checked against Paillard instruction manual 3003 B and primary photographs of serial 3138796. Not a measured reconstruction: case width, clearances, curvature, platen radius, groove counts, material chemistry and timing are not factory-verified. Synthesized sound, not recordings.
method: Articulated GLB with fixed symmetrical front camera and projected native HTML textarea paper
text: The same tbInput node moves into the projected paper and restores when changing modes; no duplicate draft or text renderer. IME commits drive carriage spacing.
parts: closed continuous curved shell with uniform front bezel and inset underside tray (87-key adaptation)
constant-radius dished mint keycaps and a separately crowned spacebar
carriage channel and separate end cheeks
paper bail with inset scale and two margin indicator bands
paper table, supports and side guide
transparent body-fixed card holders with line graduations
fixed type guide and moving ribbon carrier
continuous black-over-red 13 mm ribbon through side guides
fan segment, individual bars and two-row slug faces
layout: ANSI 87-key tenkeyless adaptation, individually placed standard key widths
lighting: Runtime studio reflection environment, coated enamel, fine surface grain, VSM shadows and contact shadow
motion: Independent key travel, 42 ms typebar strike, delayed 58 ms carriage step, 390 ms return and 180 ms paper feed; platen angle follows travel / 18 mm radius
dimensions_status: width_m and other mesh dimensions are authored parameters for this 87-key adaptation; no verified keyboard-cheek or bezel measurements available

verified_facts.finding: Left/right margin positions are displayed inside paper bail; not an independent lower ruler.
Transparent holders have graduations showing writing line; not solid metal blocks.
1/2 inch (13 mm); black/red ribbon red at bottom; separate side guides and carrier.
Both knobs feed paper; left knob can be pulled out to release platen indexing.
Owner photos show rounded keyboard cheeks, low central spacebar recess, dished caps and two-row reversed slug faces; no manufacturing dimensions provided.

adaptation_limits: 87 keys and 47 web printable bars are custom, not original keyboard count.
Scale divisions and indicator positions follow the web sheet, not a measured factory scale.
Paper-release, margin-stop and line-spacing levers are modeled but do not yet expose manual pointer controls.
Groove/slot tessellation and PBR numeric values are rendering choices, not measured parts specifications.
No internal escapement, ratchet or spring transmission is asserted as reconstructed.
finish_revision: Rebuilt closed enclosure and keyboard bed, inset bottom tray, lowered decorative linkage, shared cap corner radii and surface-conforming legends. All clearances are authored, not factory measurements.
